levels.full:
# Going to

## Core concept
Be going to + base verb expresses plans and predictions based on present evidence.

## How it works
Choose am/is/are to match the subject: I am going to study; they are going to travel.

## What to watch out for
For negatives put not after be; for questions invert be and the subject.

## Worked example
Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.

## Try it yourself
Write a new example using the rule and explain why it works.
